---
title: "AEDT: HFSS Driven Modal"
description: "HFSS Driven Modal waits for its ports on the SGB model (issue #135)."
scgsim-kind: "course"
scgsim-status: "CONVERGING"
scgsim-id: "docs/course/aedt-driven-modal"
---

HFSS runs on the SGB model, the same model Palace meshes, and SCGSim builds no
AEDT geometry itself. A Driven Modal port (`ModalPort`) has no realization on
that model yet: `prepare_sgb_model` refuses a request that declares one, naming
[issue #135](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/scgsim/issues/135), where Driven
Modal ports and Driven Terminal wave ports follow. The earlier Modal workflow
built its model from a GDS import (`HfssDrivenSpec`, `gds_path`, `LayerImport`,
`ObjectBinding`, `LengthMeshSpec`); that route is removed.

For a two-port network response today, use
[HFSS Driven Terminal](aedt-driven-terminal.qmd) with lumped ports on the
model's port sheets.
